mapper.select: /* AppAdminAccessMapper.selectAccessibleSites */ SELECT S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NO AS siteNo , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm FROM TB_USER_SITE_AUTH USA INNER JOIN TB_SITE S ON S.CMPNY_CD = USA.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = USA.SITE_CD WHERE USA.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USA.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND USA.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.SITE_NM, S.SITE_CD LIMIT 100
